Definition: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be satisfied, be sated, be fulfilled, be surfeited; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be sated (with food); 1a2) to be sated, be satisfied with, be fulfilled, be filled, have one's fill of (have desire satisfied); 1a3) to have in excess, be surfeited, be surfeited with; 1a3a) to be weary of (fig); 1b) (Piel) to satisfy; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to satisfy; 1c2) to enrich; 1c3) to sate, glut (with the undesired)
